stories.title: After backlash, Tamil Nadu government withdraws G.O. exempting Public (Law and Order) Department from RTI Act

en.title: After backlash, Tamil Nadu government withdraws G.O. exempting Public (Law and Order) Department from RTI Act
en.summary: Tamil Nadu government retracted a Government Order that had exempted the Public Law and Order Department from RTI Act requirements after facing criticism. The exemption had excluded information on communal clashes, police firing inquiries, custodial deaths, and National Security Act detentions.
